purpose: Before-state and rollback record for the first server-owned behavior lifecycle deployment.
protected_invariants: Marketing consent is explicit and independent of account creation, billing, gifting, or redemption.
Unsubscribed and suppressed contacts are never resubscribed by product synchronization.
Only the Our Little World audience may receive Our Little World lifecycle state.
No child, family, photo, video, caption, letter, date, location, gift note, or redemption data enters Mailchimp.
Transactional gift delivery remains outside the marketing provider path.

rollback.application: Redeploy sync-marketing-contacts from git commit 116aa9b or restore the recorded version-6 bundle.
rollback.database: Disable lifecycle claims by redeploying version 6 first. The new ledger and triggers are additive; queued rows can be canceled without deleting product or consent records. Do not drop the ledger until provider writes are stopped and evidence is exported.
rollback.mailchimp: Remove or deactivate only tags prefixed olw-state-, olw-lifecycle-, olw-activated-, olw-value-, olw-conversion-, olw-converted-, olw-gift-, or olw-entitlement-. Do not alter subscription status or the internal-qa tag.
rollback.journey: Keep journey 7274 unchanged until product event synchronization passes controlled readback. Restore the current linear journey from the existing Mailchimp campaign/template snapshots if a later branch edit fails.
